error.notMidi: This file isn't a MIDI file (.mid).
error.smpte: This MIDI file uses SMPTE timing (film/video time code). Only files with bars and beats (ticks per quarter note) can be imported.
error.truncated: This MIDI file is damaged or incomplete.
error.noTracks: This MIDI file has no tracks.
error.noNotes: This MIDI file doesn't contain any notes.
error.tooLarge: This MIDI file is too big (more than 4 MB).
error.unreadable: The MIDI file couldn't be read.

note.splitRange: “{name}” spans more than two octaves and was split by register into {count} tracks.
note.tempoAdjusted: Tempo {original} BPM was set to {bpm} BPM (whole numbers from 40 to 220).
note.tempoDefault: The file has no tempo – using {bpm} BPM.
note.tempoChanges: The tempo changes during the piece – mixr plays everything at {bpm} BPM.
note.timeSignature: The piece is in {signature} – mixr counts in 4/4 bars, so bar lines may be in different places (the notes stay where they are).

quantized.one: {count} note didn't sit exactly on a 16th – moved to the nearest 16th.
quantized.other: {count} notes didn't sit exactly on a 16th (e.g. triplets, swing or played live) – moved to the nearest 16th.

note.songCapped: {count} notes after bar {bars} were left out.
note.loop: The piece ({bars} bars) repeats every {loop} bars – imported as a loop.

arrangement.one: The piece ({bars} bars) became a song arrangement with {count} section – each different part of a track is its own track that is switched on in the right sections.
arrangement.other: The piece ({bars} bars) became a song arrangement with {count} sections – each different part of a track is its own track that is switched on in the right sections.

note.truncated: The piece ({bars} bars) is too varied for a song arrangement – only the first 16 bars were imported as a loop.

tracksCapped.one: {count} more track was left out (at most {max}).
tracksCapped.other: {count} more tracks were left out (at most {max}).

note.drums: Drum notes turned into a step grid (kit “modern”) – same rhythm.
note.drumsLong: The drum pattern is {bars} bars long – kept as a sample block with one bar per step (<…>), same rhythm.
note.drumDropped: Drum notes without a matching sound were left out: {notes}.

melody.one: Notes turned into a melody block ({root} {scale}, octave {octave}, {count} bar) – same notes.
melody.other: Notes turned into a melody block ({root} {scale}, octave {octave}, {count} bars) – same notes.

note.noteCode: The notes don't fit into one scale – kept as exact note code (note("…")).

heldShortened.one: {count} held note was shortened at the end of the pattern.
heldShortened.other: {count} held notes were shortened at the end of the pattern.

note.sound: Instrument “{from}” is played with the sound “{to}”.
note.velocityPattern: The notes have very different velocities – the track volume is the average, the accents are kept as a code block (velocity).

export.trackSkipped: “{track}” has no playable source and was left out.
export.trackFailed: “{track}” couldn't be evaluated (code error) and was left out.
export.trackSilent: “{track}” plays no notes in this length and was left out.
export.channelsShared: More than {count} melodic tracks – some share a MIDI channel.
export.percussion: Samples without a pitch ({names}) were written to channel 10 as percussion.

ui.exportIntro: Saves the notes your project plays as a MIDI file (.mid) – for DAWs, notation programs or hardware.
ui.whatTitle: What ends up in the file
ui.whatNotes: Every note Strudel plays – including code blocks, setup code and the song arrangement.
ui.whatDrums: Drums on channel 10 (General MIDI), other samples as percussion.
ui.whatNot: Sounds and effects (filter, reverb …) are not part of MIDI – a DAW plays the notes with its own instruments.

whatTracks.one: {count} track will be exported (muted tracks are left out).
whatTracks.other: {count} tracks will be exported (muted tracks are left out).

ui.noTracks: There are no audible tracks to export.
ui.toastFailed: The MIDI file couldn't be created.
ui.dropText: A MIDI file (.mid) becomes tracks with drum grids and melodies.
